verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B300 is datacenter GPU hardware (the DGX B300 system), not a hosted service or API with production data, so a sandbox or test-mode environment is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability. The only isolation-adjacent item, self-encrypting drives, is a storage feature and not a sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
